title: LoRAQuant: Mixed-Precision Quantization of LoRA to Ultra-Low Bits
abstract: arXiv:2510.26690v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a popular technique for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). In many real-world scenarios, multiple adapters are loaded simultaneously to enable LLM customization for personalized user experiences or to support a diverse range of tasks. Although each adapter is lightweight in isolation, their aggregate cost becomes substantial at scale. To address this, we propose LoRAQuant, a mixed-precision post-training quantization method tailored to LoRA. Specifically, LoRAQuant reparameterizes each adapter by singular value decomposition (SVD) to concentrate the most important information into specific rows and columns. This makes it possible to quantize the important components to higher precision, while quantizing the rest to ultra-low bitwidth. We conduct comprehensive experiments with LLaMA 2-7B, LLaMA 2-13B, and Mistral 7B models on mathematical reasoning, coding, and summar

translated_title: LoRAQuant：将LoRA混合精度量化至极低位宽
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2510.26690v3 公告类型：替换  摘要：低秩适应（LoRA）已成为大型语言模型（LLMs）参数高效微调的热门技术。在许多实际场景中，多个适配器同时加载，以实现LLM的个性化用户体验定制或支持多样化任务。尽管每个适配器单独看很轻量，但其总体成本在规模上变得可观。为解决这一问题，我们提出了LoRAQuant，一种专为LoRA定制的混合精度训练后量化方法。具体而言，LoRAQuant通过奇异值分解（SVD）重新参数化每个适配器，将最重要的信息集中到特定行和列中。这使得可以将重要组件量化为更高精度，而其余部分则量化为超低位宽。我们使用LLaMA 2-7B、LLaMA 2-13B和Mistral 7B模型在数学推理、编码和摘要任务上进行了全面实验。
tldr: LoRAQuant通过奇异值分解重新参数化LoRA适配器，实现混合精度量化，将重要组件保留高精度、其余部分压缩至超低位宽，从而在保持性能的同时大幅降低多适配器部署的存储和计算成本。
en_tdlr: LoRAQuant reparameterizes LoRA adapters via singular value decomposition to enable mixed-precision quantization, preserving high precision for important components while compressing the rest to ultra-low bits, thereby significantly reducing storage and computational costs for multi-adapter deployment without sacrificing performance.
